metadata.portfolio_status: All 10 assets and asset financials are fictional; official aggregate market indices are separately sourced.

model_revision.warning: Public indices may be revised; historical index dates do not establish historical availability.

units.npv: expected incremental unlevered net present value versus Hold, unless explicitly otherwise labelled
units.risk: 95% CVaR of positive-part incremental portfolio loss; average of worst 5% with exact finite-sample tail weights
units.ratio: decimal fraction; multiply by 100 for percent

noi_decision_frontier.secondary_chart_label: Expected incremental NPV vs Hold (S$ million)
noi_decision_frontier.note: Requested cap of 8 concurrent projects replaces the saved cap of 20; neither binds because each solution schedules at most one active development. Capital release is sale proceeds, not profit or net cash after capex. Holding-floor constraints apply in each of the five annual scheduling buckets; no reinvestment strategy is modeled.

illustrative_asset.name: Demo Mixed use Asset 1

selection.return_basis: annual equivalent incremental NPV yield; do not add to NOI yield or historical price growth
selection.acquisition_signal: Not assessed: transaction price and benchmark evidence required

opportunity.interpretation: Modelled opportunity versus Hold, not excess realised return. Additional discounted costs consume the break-even cost allowance one-for-one.

enbloc.warning: Screening probability only. Owner consent, Land Betterment Charge, acquisition premium and technical feasibility require project evidence.

reasons: Ranking uses expected incremental NPV minus 0.3 times nonnegative loss CVaR, with Hold as the counterfactual.
En-bloc, transformation and spatial screens are hypotheses requiring underwriting; they are not added to action NPV.
Surrounding geometry is unavailable; zero obstruction or supply risk has not been established.

Outstanding evidence: synthetic_financials, current_valuation_m, noi_m, site_area_sqm, existing_gfa_sqm, title_lot, tenure, evidence_source, data_owner, verified_financial_evidence, verified_title_and_planning, valuation_date, evidence_date, verified_action_costs_and_cashflows
selection.warning: Screening model only. No demonstrated alpha. Unverified option values are excluded to avoid overlap with cash-flow valuation.

approval.duration_basis: time to success or stopping failure, not successful-completion duration
approval.redesign_probability_status: legacy alias for failure; redesign itself is not estimated

illustrative_asset.explanation: The screened Sell action has positive incremental value under illustrative assumptions, but the finite simulated loss tail and missing evidence prevent investment sign-off. Hold at zero is a comparison baseline, not a claim that holding is risk free.

envelope.method: Screening-level 3D envelope; requires architect, surveyor, parking, fire access and daylight verification

redevelopment.npv_basis: expected unlevered incremental cashflows versus Hold
redevelopment.irr_basis: probability-weighted equity investment, including current-asset opportunity cost; not incremental IRR
redevelopment.financing_basis: success-conditional development debt; draws added to equity, interest paid monthly, principal repaid on sale; excluded from unlevered NPV

lbc.warning: LBC sector/use-group rate must be supplied from the current SLA table

decision_blockers: LBC is missing; reported numeric values exclude an unknown charge and are not decision-ready
Asset values, planning, dates, taxes, costs and approval assumptions are not verified
assumptions: predevelopment fees are sunk before approval; failed approval retains Hold cashflows
NOI yield, lease-up, financing, growth and approval are supplied assumptions, not calibrated forecasts
existing debt, corporate income tax, ABSD, tenure top-up and other unprovided levies are excluded; verify applicability

lbc.warning: LBC sector/use-group rate must be supplied from the current SLA table

enbloc.consent_method: uncalibrated independent equal-weight owner-support screen; not a legal vote or observed approval probability
enbloc.value_basis: legacy expected value is success-weighted sale component only; incremental value includes retained-asset fallback versus same-date Hold
enbloc.finance_basis: supplied effective development financing allowance on construction and professional costs; acquisition finance and tenure top-up are excluded
decision_blockers: LBC is missing; residual and indicative values exclude an unknown charge
Site, market, costs, taxes and ownership/voting assumptions are unverified
Consent uses an uncalibrated equal-owner proxy; actual legal voting shares are unavailable

development_case.takeaway: Physical redevelopment capacity is not a financial recommendation: the detailed monthly project is S$37.02m worse than Hold in this fictional example, before unresolved LBC. Development debt is kept outside unlevered project NPV.

methodology.prediction_inputs: Observable underwriting only; no latent simulation truth
methodology.risk_source: Assumed shared economic and cost Student-t(6) factors, idiosyncratic shocks, approval branches
methodology.evaluation_source: Separate random seed plus hidden simulation effects; one outcome per action/environment
methodology.tail_bounds: Student-t outcomes are unbounded and illustrate incremental-NPV model risk; not legal liability bounds
methodology.hold_baseline: Incremental Hold NPV and risk are zero; retained asset value remains in baseline PV
methodology.context_coverage: Populated fields, not verification; legacy real_context_pct is a compatibility alias

digital_twins.warning: This is a separate synthetic financial-history experiment, not the same cash-flow calibration as the core portfolio. Do not combine its NPV values with the core frontier. No demonstrated alpha or observed real-world accuracy. Zero CVaR in bounded synthetic draws is not proof of no risk.

client_takeaways: Translate an income-retention policy into a feasible asset plan, released capital and explicit downside.
A strong system can reject an attractive physical development story when the discounted cash flows do not support it.
Treat model outputs as traceable research candidates: observed asset evidence, calibrated assumptions and independent validation are the next client pilot gates.
slide_disclosure: Illustrative fictional portfolio; S$ million; model outputs are not investment recommendations or demonstrated alpha.
